parts: Hopefully this is not an off-topic question. I love lavaan and it is the best SEM programme for me. I am, however, planning on conducting a simulation study on ESEM with R. Instead of using Mplus, I wonder if people here may have suggestions of R library that will make the entire process (ESEM + coding) smooth and easy. Thank you in advance!

I only know of ESEM being available in Mplus.  So maybe try the MplusAutomation package to automate the process of writing scripts, running models, and importing results as data.frames into R.

Terry
